question: Does a source-calibrated uncertain sharing prior retain A27 precision while allowing independent risk archives, with proper nested exclusion?
calibration: For each outer held pair, train on both groups of the other7 pairs. For every inner scored pair, remove both outer-held and inner-scored pairs from population components:24 population archives, plus the explicit inner local archive. The scored pair local prior uses its original7 tasks only. Sum half the matched and half the co-shift conditional risk predictive log scores, so the same paid labels are not treated as independent duplicate observations. Uniform Beta(1,1) reference over q, with empirical predictive-score posterior. Issue the expected q and retain its moments; no argmax or q floors.
held_prediction: Evaluate the outer held pair with28 population archives plus the original local archive, exactly as A30. Use the calibrated mean q to integrate its shared/separate state; retain source q uncertainty and target-prefix sharing-state probability. C-I is primary in all4 source strata; C-J, C-A and C-U references are retained. A full-risk model CG uses identical archive evidence structure and the same issued sharing prior, omitting only risk anisotropy.
numerics: 64-point Gauss-Legendre primary q reference; confirm128/256 without changing primary parameters. Maximum held forecast log-score change1e-4. No Gaussian prediction is recomputed.
controls: Require complete A30 cache and original cohort. Every training profile population excludes both held pairs. Mutating outer-held observations and their per-archive evidence columns must not alter training branch arrays or issued prior. q=1/0 reproduce J/A; q=1/2 reproduces U. Proper sharing evidence uses f/g and eta past only; future labels affect scores only.
analysis: Eight-pair-block bootstrap20000, all four source strata and early9-12/late21-24 contrasts. Retain calibrated q mean/sd, posterior shared-state probabilities and local/population risk mass. No inference of deployment risk-only-shift frequency from these natural panels.
decision: A source-calibrated uncertainty model with no coherent compatible loss may proceed to a separately frozen target test. Otherwise no target/recommendation promotion. In either case, a separately frozen cross-head-record diagnostic may test whether the genuine source panels teach risk-only decoupling; recombination is not physical co-observed data and cannot establish deployment frequency.
resource_admission: Retain the first complete outer-pair calibration including64/128/256 confirmations; project8 fits with1.25 safety factor plus5 CPU seconds summary reserve. Stop within30 CPU seconds.
information_cost: Calibration uses28 original source archives172032 paid calls outside each held pair; each training prediction has24 external population archives plus its local source7-task prior. Held prediction has28 external archives plus local. All calls are historical and reused.
limitations: An empirical predictive-score posterior, not an exact joint-label likelihood posterior. Overlapping source priors and forecast prefixes limit posterior-coverage interpretation. The source distribution has no naturally co-observed risk-only support changes. Added q uncertainty may have irreducible compatible cost; no independent target evidence.
